outcome: Placental long chain polyunsaturated fatty acid (LCPUFA) uptake (oleic acid, arachidonic acid, DHA)
mRNA expression of fatty acid transporters (FATP-4, CD36, FABPpm)
cohort: Japanese macaques were fed control chow, a high fat diet, or a high fat diet with resveratrol prior to and throughout pregnancy.
finding: Resveratrol supplementation increased placental uptake of DHA, AMP-activated protein kinase activity, and fatty acid transporter expression, while HFD alone had no measurable effect on LCPUFA uptake, though placental DHA content was decreased in HFD dams.
